description:
FOUND s473t5e (#1501 round 6, `re/` CHECK 2).  t/re/pat_rt_report.t is DIFF
2458/52 with 58 blessed fail rows over **56 distinct assertion shapes** -- the
`op/`-shaped population (1.04 rows per cluster), not the `re/`-shaped one, so
it has no single fact and it is the one `re/` file the round's "name the fact
once per file" rule does not fit.

The shapes that repeat, and the classes visible in one reading of the log:
  * `Match UTF-8 char in presence of (??{ })` -- NS:Regex code blocks
  * `$c =~ /$c/i : chr (N) : u_str = N u_pat = N` -- #1036 (case folding)
  * `Ill-formed UTF-8 doesn't match NUL in class` -- malformed-UTF-8 handling
  * `Optimizer doesn't prematurely reject match` (x2),
    `Correct pmop flags checked when empty pattern` (x2) -- engine internals
  * `Propagated modifier; in multiline regexp - with /m` -- `(missing)`, i.e.
    behind the file's own stop

WHAT TO DO WITH IT: not a fix target as a file.  Treat it the way `op/` is
treated -- when another task closes one of the classes above, its rows here
close with it.  Before spending a session, count how many of the 58 fall to
#1036 and to NS:Regex code blocks; if that is most of them, the file needs no
task of its own and this one closes as SUPERSEDED.
subject: t/re/pat_rt_report.t is 58 rows over 56 distinct assertions -- perl's regex bug-report grab-bag; no single fact, and the clusters that do repeat are (??{ }) code blocks and /i case folding
